# GVRN-AI Automation (gvrn-ai.com.au)

> Australian AI automation partner that shows you the test results before you pay. Voice agents, workflow automation, RAG chatbots, dashboards, contact centre AI — with published evaluation results for every build. Melbourne-based, serving Australia and global clients.

## Services
- AI voice agents, n8n workflow automation, RAG chatbots, business dashboards, contact centre AI
- AI Evals & Assurance: independent testing of AI systems before deployment (our edge)
- AI for Business Leaders: executive training (half-day)
- AI-Native Transformation: structured programs converting SMBs to AI-native operations
- Change management for AI adoption; AI-lifecycle delivery (continuous evals vs Agile/PRINCE2 stage gates)

## Pricing
- Automation Audit: $2,500 AUD — fee fully credited to your implementation within 30 days
- ADM Transparency Check: $1,900 AUD fixed — privacy policy compliant with the automated-decision-making disclosure obligation before 10 December 2026 (covers rule-based systems and spreadsheets, not just AI)
- AI Readiness Roadmap: $4,500 AUD fixed — whole-of-business, vendor-neutral AI strategy with tool selection and ROI model
- Managed AI: from $1,500 AUD/month — post-build monitoring, tuning, and monthly evaluation re-runs
- AI Training Ladder: staff foundations, role-based workshops, executive enablement; prompt playbooks included
- Grant-eligible pathways: Victorian and federal programs subsidise AI adoption planning — ask
- Independence guarantee: we don't sell you the build; sometimes the answer is "don't automate this"
